007 - Quantum of Solace.name: 007: Quantum of Solace
007 - Quantum of Solace.summary: In the Nintendo DS version of 007: Quantum of Solace, players control James Bond in a top-down third-person action experience that differs significantly from the console versions. Played with the system held sideways, the game relies heavily on touchscreen controls for movement, aiming, shooting, and interacting with icons. At the same time, the buttons are used mainly to initiate melee combat. It also features a progression system based on collectible casino chips and cards that can be used to enhance Bond’s abilities.

Battle Spirits Digital Starter.name: Battle Spirits Digital Starter
Battle Spirits Digital Starter.summary: Battle Spirits Digital Starter (バトルスピリッツ デジタルスターター) is the third Battle Spirits video game, and the first to appear on the Nintento DS. It was released August 5, 2010 in Japan, and is not licensed elsewhere.

Dolphin Trainer.name: Dolphin Trainer
Dolphin Trainer.summary:
Become a friend to the dolphins!

Adopt a dolphin and teach it incredible acrobatic tricks to save the aquatic park from financial collapse.

Dreamer Series - Babysitter.name: Dreamer Series: Babysitter
Dreamer Series - Babysitter.summary: With Dreamer: Babysitter you can see what it takes to be a great babysitter!

My Amusement Park.name: My Amusement Park
My Amusement Park.summary:
In My Amusement Park, kids step into the driver’s seat to run their own amusement park. In Digging for Dinosaurs, kids will separate fact from myth to learn the true tales about 21 different dinosaurs. With these smart games, parents can rest assured that kids build skills while they play.

Build the Park: Choose from four different theme park plans then build rides, food venues and special attractions to

open your theme park!

Fix the Rides: Customers don’t like broken rides! Use your logic skills to repair the rides and keep the customers happy.

Keep It Going: Running an amusement park isn’t all about rides and games. Use matching clues to fulfill food orders, keep the park clean and more!

Earn Money: Play eight different memory and puzzle games to earn money to build a bigger, better park with larger and more expensive rides and attractions!

Make It Your Own: Control the look of the park—from its theme to the design of the rides to the landscaping and decorations.

Professor Layton and the Diabolical Box.name: Professor Layton and the Diabolical Box
Professor Layton and the Diabolical Box.summary: Professor Layton may be a world-famous sleuth, but even he will need your assistance to crack these challenging puzzles. With Nintendo DS stylus in hand, it's time to muster up some mental might!

Soma Bringer.name: Soma Bringer
Soma Bringer.summary:

This is a world where an energy called Soma dominates.

Lately, the balance of Soma tipped, and a mysterious life form, called visitors appeared and people started to live in fear. To defeat these visitors, the people established a military group called the Falsif. Texas Hold 'em Poker DS.name: Texas Hold 'Em Poker
Texas Hold 'em Poker DS.summary: This game follows the rules and nuances of the community card game Texas hold 'em.
